playstyle: Mid-range monster. Stop the opponent's approach with safe neutral tools (b+2, df+1, b+3), use the huge range of his lows and launchers, and build Gamma Charge for armoured, guard-breaking hits. Wavu warns he has no i10 jab and a huge, slow body, so he struggles when pressured up close.

stances.name: Gamma Howl
stances.entry: 3+4, or D after f,F+1 and ss2
stances.note: GMH.4 and GMH.3+4 are Heat Engagers; GMH.2 is +11g on block.

stances.name: Gamma Charge
stances.entry: 3+4 while absorbing a hit, or landing hold moves on hit or block
stances.note: Charged versions: GMC.2 guard-breaks and is +11 on block. In Heat, Gamma Charge moves are always active (Wavu).

keyMoves: His fastest standing button (no i10 jab, Wavu).
Pinpoint Assault: i10 high, -12 on block, launches on counter hit.
To stop approaches and check ducking.
Piston Gun Assault: i19 mid, +2 on block, Heat Engager.
A plus, long mid and Heat Engager.
To stop approaches and start Heat.
Mimesis Wrench Kick: i15 mid, -9 on block.
Programmed Uppercut: i15 launcher, -14 on block.
Killing Uppercut: i15 while-standing launcher, -13 on block.
Toe Smash: i11 while-standing kick, -6 on block.
Tornado Punch: i15 homing instant tornado, -13 on block.
A homing launcher with high evasion.
i10 special-mid crouch jab, -5 on block.
Big Boot: i16 low, -13 on block.
Wavu: incredible range on his lows.
Tyulpan Blast: i14 Heat Engager, -19 on block.
Rotary Catapult: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2.

combos.name: CH f+2 → f,F+4
combos.situation: Your f+2 lands as a counter hit (+32a).
mistakes: Following up on a normal hit: only on the counter-hit animation.
